$Comment: The Headless Horseman's graveyard, the dungeon the Gravekeeper near Old Jack opens while Hallow's
Eve runs. Every area of a copy pastes Hallows_Eve/Hallows_Eve_Graveyard.prefab.json (an enclosed
night graveyard with his fight's entity, his spawn marker and a way-out pad in its entrance
room; tools/arena_markers.py writes it), so every fresh paste stages a fresh fight. The prefab's
anchor is the entrance room's floor, so EntryOffset lands an arriving party one block up, standing
on it; the Leave_Instance pad behind them takes a player back out.
Season keeps it closed outside Hallow's Eve. Share: one party to an area, up to five players, and
four areas to a copy. Complete names his fight, so the run clears when he falls, and Rewards rolls
Hallows_Eve_Graveyard_Clear for each member present as a Claim: full the first clear each day,
half on later ones. Text names it in the reader's language (hallowseve.world.lang), and its GoalKey
is the line each player reads as they arrive: what to do there, and how his fight is won.
